# Delib · 審議拼圖

Delib helps non-engineers compose offline and online deliberation workflows,
select open-source tools, and leave an inspectable receipt for the next round.

- Human site: https://delib.mashbean.net/
- Agent skill: https://delib.mashbean.net/.well-known/delib/SKILL.md
- Tool registry: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/tools.json
- Integration audit: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/integrations.json
- Source and hosting audit: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/hosting.json
- Integration API: https://delib.mashbean.net/api/integrations
- Source: https://github.com/mashbean/delib

Recommendations are deterministic and source-linked. AI may explain or format a
selected workflow but must not invent consensus, participant evidence, or
decision authority.

Direct actions currently implemented:

- POST /api/integrations/call-in — create a confirmed seven-day hosted event.
- POST /api/integrations/polis — validate and prepare an embedded Pol.is workspace.
- GET /api/integrations/polis/status — report whether this deployment has a connected Site ID.
- POST /api/integrations/heyform — validate and prepare an existing public HeyForm workspace.
- POST /api/integrations/tttc — prepare the current official Talk to the City create workspace.
- POST /api/integrations/harmonica — create a confirmed Harmonica session with a tab-only API key.
- /integrations/power-ranker.html — run local pairwise ranking or join a short-lived aggregate room; no account or API key.
- /results/power-ranker.html#receipt=… — render a de-linked aggregate result receipt with organizer interpretation, missing voices, decision status and next responsibility. Receipt data stays in the URL fragment and is not stored by Delib.
- /schemas/delib-ranking-receipt/v1.json — machine-readable contract for a layered Power Ranker result receipt.
- /schemas/delib-handoff/v1.json — machine-readable contract for a two-hour, one-time, same-tab next-step draft.
- POST /api/integrations/power-ranker/rooms — after human confirmation, create a 24-hour or seven-day SQLite Durable Object room.
- GET/DELETE /api/integrations/power-ranker/rooms/:id — read thresholded aggregates or delete with a fragment-held admin token.
- POST /api/integrations/power-ranker/rooms/:id/submissions — immediately reduce one browser session to pair counts; raw judgments are not stored.

Every preparation or external-write path requires an explicit human gate.
HeyForm, TTTC and Harmonica participant data remain upstream; Harmonica
credentials are forwarded once and never stored by Delib. Power Ranker local
judgments and imported files stay in browser memory. Optional rooms store only
the public question, pair counts and hashed random session IDs until expiry or
organizer deletion. Downloaded ranking files explicitly declare participant data.
Only an aggregate can become a public result receipt. Individual session IDs,
raw judgments and room admin tokens are excluded; publication requires a human
statement of authority, limitations and next action.
From a valid receipt, the browser may prepare a minimized draft for Call-in,
Harmonica, TTTC or Pol.is. It carries no pair counts, raw judgments, session
IDs, receipt URL, admin capability or credential. It is consumed once from
same-tab sessionStorage and does not bypass the destination's normal human
confirmation gate. TTTC still requires a separate de-identified qualitative
CSV; Pol.is receives no seed statements.
